name: Claude Ship
desc: Agent that reviews pull requests, fixes them and applies merge policy
desc_zh: 自动审查 PR、修复问题并按团队规则推进合并的智能体
solves: Pull requests pile up faster than reviewers can read them; Claude Ship reviews, fixes and merges by your team's policy.
solves_zh: PR 积压得比评审快，Claude Ship 按团队设定的规则审查、修复并推进合并。
best_for: Your team merged an agent-written change late Friday and needs a careful review before Monday's release.
best_for_zh: 周五深夜合入了智能体写的改动，想在周一发版前得到一次细致审查。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：C — https://techcrunch.com/category/artificial-intelligence/ (then D: claude.com）。 Beta on Team and Enterprise plans, GitHub repositories. Distinct from Code Review: the launch article says Code Review 'is rolling out in Claude Code and the desktop app starting today'. 首次公开日期来源：https://claude.com/resources/articles/introducing-claude-ship
